description: trainheroic-unofficial.com documents an unofficial toolkit for accessing the TrainHeroic platform, including hosted and local MCP tooling, a CLI, and an export page. It is a separate project from TrainHeroic and wraps an undocumented upstream TrainHeroic API.
summary: Public integration surfaces on trainheroic-unofficial.com are a hosted MCP server at `mcp.trainheroic-unofficial.com` (main, coach-only, and athlete-only endpoints) plus the `trainheroic` CLI distributed on npm; both require TrainHeroic account credentials, and no public HTTP/GraphQL API spec is documented on this domain.
